terminology_test.formography_explanation: A bounded method for mapping one declared question through alternative factorization, typed scoped relations, source-custodied claims, and explicit projection loss. It keeps boundaries visible, lets competing decompositions coexist, and preserves enough provenance for critique, reuse, and comparison without pretending any one map is universal.
terminology_test.governed_property_graph_explanation: A source-governed property-graph practice for representing one bounded frame with alternative factorizations, typed scoped edges, custody-aware claims, and declared loss in any projection. It separates the map from the authority behind it and keeps reviewable boundaries around each representation.
terminology_test.reason: It names the contract directly and keeps authority and projection boundaries explicit.
